per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The prior open ticket was resolved by owner-layer source review and concrete cautions; accepted_with_cautions is used rather than accepted_clean.

caution_findings.evidence_context: S2 Table values measure LP90 producer colony/CFS inhibition zones against S. pneumoniae strains, not purified peptide MICs.
Primary source supports predicted InfA1/InfA2 identity but ties anti-pneumococcal activity to a modified 3963 Da InfA1 form; the unmodified predicted mass is not normalized as the active form.
The purified InfA1 activity statement is source-supported, but local material does not tabulate an exact inhibition value for that purified fraction.
PPT/image supplement surfaces were checked through the packet inventory/captions; they did not alter the recoverable worker-2/4/6 gate result and no image-only value was fabricated.

summary: Worker-2/4/6 source re-review recovered LP90 S2 activity rows, preserved the APD6 modified-InfA1 caution, and strict semantic/publication gates now pass as accepted_with_cautions.
